en:
<CLT=cltMIND>A new room...
It must be that.

Right? This room's really weird, isn't it?
I can't figure it out.
I'll try looking around...

I don't know what kind of room is 
on the other side of that hole, but...
It's definitely a weird room.

That room...was where we were 
in cold sleep together...
But now's not the time to be sad!

In order to fulfill the promise we made,
let's go to the hidden room in the library!

<CLT=cltMIND>I should check the room on the
other side of the hole.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like the cockpit of a spaceship...
Of course, it's just a simulator.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a document about the
Gofer Project Maki found.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>"boys and girls of exceptional talent"<CLT=cltMIND>...
is us.

<CLT=cltMIND>The Ultimate Academy itself is the
ark headed to a <CLT=cltSTRONG>new world<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like the device is about to
break. You can't see the stars...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's still dark outside...

<CLT=cltMIND>But there's not that much
time until dawn. I need to hurry.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's still dark outside...

<CLT=cltMIND>But there's not that much
time until dawn. I need to hurry.

<CLT=cltMIND>I went through the large hole in the wall
and stepped into the next room.
